preToolUse.bash: d=.; [ -x ./harness ] || d="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; [ -x "$d/harness" ] || exit 0; exec "$d/harness" adapter_guard
preToolUse.powershell: $d = '.'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$d\harness.cmd")) { $d = (git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null) }; if (-not $d -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$d\harness.cmd")) { exit 0 }; $input | & "$d\harness.cmd" adapter_guard; exit $LASTEXITCODE
